measurement.execution_timing: process spawn to exit, as observed by the parent; setup and preparation complete before spawning
measurement.run_order: problem-major and lane-minor within each warm-up or measured run index
measurement.memory: peak cgroup-v2 memory charged to a fresh cgroup containing the launched process and all descendants
measurement.memory_limitations: memory.peak includes anonymous memory, charged page cache, and kernel memory. Shared pages are charged once, potentially to a cgroup outside the measured execution, so small-footprint results depend on page-cache state and are not directly comparable across machines or reboots. It is not an RSS measurement.
